cbam_defaults.assumption_A_CBAM_1: Defaults are per CN code and exporting country, not per route. One representative CN code per route: BF-BOF=7208, EAF=7214 20 00, DRI-EAF=7207 11 14.
cbam_defaults.fallback: Countries without a steel default on their own sheet (and EU members) use the '_Other Countries and Territories' sheet, key OTHER.
cbam_defaults.markup_note: Values as published in the workbook; any year-dependent mark-up (10 % in 2026) is NOT added.
cbam_defaults.scope_note: For iron and steel the EC workbook gives direct emissions only (indirect = N/A); total == direct. Compared against a direct+indirect SEE, so the 0.5x-default rule is slightly conservative.
cbam_defaults.source: European Commission, CBAM default values (definitive period) Excel, version 2 dated 2026-08-06: Annex I of Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2621 as corrected by (EU) 2026/1740. Informational copy; only the Official Journal text is legally binding.

description: LightGBM quantile regression (q05/q50/q95) of specific embedded emissions (direct+indirect, tCO2 per t steel); target = Climate TRACE v5.10.0 modelled emissions factor, NOT a measurement.

features.label: Grid carbon intensity (gCO2/kWh)
features.name: grid_gco2_kwh
features.source: Ember yearly CO2 intensity, last observation carried forward

post_processing.calibration: one-sided split-conformal offsets on calibration plants: q05' = max(0, min(q05 - lower, q50)); q95' = max(q95 + upper, q50)
post_processing.crossing_fix: sort the three predictions per row (monotone rearrangement)

target.definition: Climate TRACE iron-and-steel `other1` (direct + indirect emissions factor)
target.name: see_tco2_per_t

training_data.source: Climate TRACE v5.10.0 iron-and-steel sources CSV (CC BY 4.0), Ember yearly electricity data (CC BY 4.0)
